Nippon Electric Glass.why: Supplies glass wafers for supporting semiconductors and probe-card glass substrates and is jointly developing inorganic (glass / glass-ceramic) core substrates with semiconductor companies for advanced packaging; also low-expansion glass fiber for package substrates.
Nippon Electric Glass.evidence: Nippon Electric Glass 2Q FY2026 results presentation 08-03-2026: inorganic core substrates (GC Core, glass core substrate) in joint development with semiconductor companies, commercialization expected in 2028 or later; glass wafer for supporting semiconductors (WSG) demand expected to recover in H2.

players.product: Glass wafers for supporting semiconductors (WSG carrier glass) and glass substrates for probe cards; inorganic core substrates (GC Core glass-ceramic core and glass core substrate) under joint development with semiconductor companies

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results meeting Q&A: Key Points of the Q&A Session 2Q FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management on the FY2026 operating profit forecast cut from 33 billion yen to 20 billion yen: unit sales and pricing approximately 1 billion yen, productivity and operation rate approximately 4 billion yen (mostly composites, some displays and medical care), material and energy prices and logistics expenses approximately 7 billion yen, others approximately 1 billion yen; it also expects higher manufacturing costs from Chinese yuan appreciation at the displays business's China base.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results meeting Q&A: Key Points of the Q&A Session 2Q FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: demand for microcapillaries and glass polarizers, used in optical communication networks, has grown rapidly in recent years due to the expansion of data centers and inter-data-center infrastructure investment; the company is investing in facilities to expand production capacity to meet the current strong demand and aims to grow each of these businesses to 10 billion yen in FY2028.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results meeting Q&A: Key Points of the Q&A Session 2Q FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: D2 fiber (low-dielectric glass fiber) is being evaluated by customers and it will take some more time; because customers want first generation fiber supplied, the company is changing its plan to start first generation and then second generation, as the market environment and demand for low-dielectric glass fibers have changed.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nippon Electric Glass results meeting Q&A: Key Points of the Q&A Session 2Q FY2026 (08-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: the composites deficit narrowed on productivity improvements but remained in H1 FY2026; with energy prices at the Malaysian base expected to rise more than expected in the second half, a negative impact of several billion yen is built into the full-year forecast. In displays, expenses for periodic melting-furnace repairs are expected mainly in Q3, with cost recovery expected in FY2027 and beyond.
